implementation: The persistent Flutter voice dock now exposes start/stop screen sharing alongside mic, deafen, and remote stream-sound controls. Start opens the same source/quality setup flow as the voice viewer; stop stops the currently published local track. Start is disabled unless voice is connected/listener and capture is idle/error; start/stop transition buttons are locked.

checks.name: Dock screen-share action presence and join-state lock
checks.command: flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "voice dock announces reconnect and deafen transition states"
checks.observation: The connected voice view contains both its in-page action and the persistent dock action; activating the dock action opens the shared source/quality setup dialog. While voice is joining, the dock action is disabled. The same widget test covers sound preference, live-region notice, and reconnect/deafen/leave states.

checks.name: macOS debug bundle compilation
checks.observation: BOOHTACORD.app built successfully for macOS. The host was locked, so this bundle could not be brought to foreground for visual or permission acceptance.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite
checks.observation: All 180 Flutter tests passed; the final added widget assertion was also rerun in the targeted dock test.

remaining: The macOS app compiled during a runtime smoke attempt, but the host was locked and Flutter reported that it could not foreground the app. Verify screen-share source/quality selection, native permissions, published video, stop and real remote playback on unlocked macOS, Windows and Android devices.
